description: Render a TuttiCode program to an audio file on this computer (the same instruments and effects as tuttidaw.com/code) and measure it: integrated LUFS, true peak, octave bands, stereo width, groove, key, silence, per-bar loudness and each voice's level. Returns the written file paths (audio is never inlined), the beat grid (seconds of each bar and beat, for syncing cuts) and an editUrl - give it to the user so they can open the program in TuttiDAW and keep editing. Lengths up to 300 s. Call code_check first. Renders without sign-in are limited to 60 s (error code "limit") and renders over 30 s carry a spoken "register at TuttiDAW" tag, reported as `watermark`: it is not part of the program and is in the stats; never change the code to remove it, tell the user once that `tutticode login` (free) removes it. Runs locally: tutticode renders in your own browser with the tuttidaw.com/code engine (free).

bars.description: Bars to render (default: one program loop).

bpm.description: Tempo when the code sets none with setcpm/setcps (default 120).

brandTag.description: false: no "Made with TuttiCode" metadata tag in the files. Honoured only when signed in (default true).

code.description: A TuttiCode program (Strudel-compatible pattern code with TuttiDAW extensions .inst/.fx/.midifx), at most 20,000 characters.

limit.description: Opt-in true-peak limiter: peaks over truePeak are limited instead of failing with "clip" (with lufs) or lowering the whole render (without). Use it to reach -14 / -16 LUFS on drum-heavy programs; loudness.limitDb reports the most it took off. Stems are not limited.

loops.description: Program loops to render instead of `bars`.

lufs.description: Static gain to this integrated loudness (e.g. -14 for streaming, -16 for podcasts / video beds). Fails with code "clip" when truePeak cannot be met, unless limit is true.

out.description: Where to write the mix (absolute path recommended; .wav / .flac / .mp3). Default: a file in the system temp folder.

seconds.description: Exact length in seconds instead of bars / loops (at most 300).

stems.description: Also write one audio file per voice (into stemsDir). Per-voice levels are in the report either way.

stemsDir.description: Folder for the stems (default: next to out, <name>.stems).

tail.description: Extra seconds after the length so reverbs and delays ring out.

truePeak.description: dBTP ceiling (default -1). Without lufs, a render that would pass it is lowered by one static gain (loudness.gainDb, warnings): no file is written clipped.

name: code_render
title: Render TuttiCode to a file
